action_instruction: Checking the results table column headers
intent: whether the results table displays the required flight result column headers

action_params.condition: A results table is shown with the headers "Choose", "Flight #", "Airline", "Departs: São Paolo", "Arrives: Cairo", and "Price".
action_params.query: whether the results table displays the required flight result column headers
action_params.code_js: (() => { const headers = Array.from(el(5).querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()); const expected = ['Choose','Flight #','Airline','Departs: São Paolo','Arrives: Cairo','Price']; return expected.every((value, index) => headers[index] === value); })()
